text: Training Objectives: This major aims to cultivate international students with professional ethics and social responsibility, innovative consciousness, teamwork spirit, and an international perspective, solid knowledge and skills in business management, economics, and trade, etc., strong language advantages and familiarity with Chinese culture, as well as good communication skills. Innovative and applied international business management professionals who can engage in trade, operation, and management in various organizational forms of enterprises and institutions. Core Courses: Microeconomics, Macroeconomics, Principles of Management, Operations Research, Management Information Systems, Accounting, Statistics, International Marketing, Operations Management, Strategic Management of Enterprises, Innovation Management, Financial Management, etc.
